$$D(R)=\frac{\frac{4\pi}{3}r^{3}\rho_{e}}{4\pi R^{2}}=\frac{\rho_{e}r^{3}}{3R^{2}}\tag{77}$$

$$E(R)=\frac{D(R)}{\varepsilon_{r2}\varepsilon_{0}}=\frac{\rho_{c}r^{3}}{3\varepsilon_{r2}\varepsilon_{0}R^{2}}\quad[2']\tag{78}$$

由于自由电荷存在，球体内部有极化电荷分布。

$$D(R)=\frac{\frac{4\pi}{3}R^{3}\rho_{e}}{4\pi R^{2}}=\frac{\rho_{c}R}{3}\tag{79}$$

$$P(R)=\frac{\varepsilon_{r1}-1}{\varepsilon_{r1}}D(R)=\frac{\varepsilon_{r1}-1}{\varepsilon_{r1}}\frac{\rho_e R}{3}\tag{80}$$

$$\rho _ { b } = - \nabla \cdot \boldsymbol { P } ( \boldsymbol { R } ) = - \frac { 1 } { R ^ { 2 } } \frac { \mathrm { d } ( R ^ { 2 } \boldsymbol { P } ( \boldsymbol { R } ) ) } { \mathrm { d } R } = - \frac { \varepsilon _ { r 1 } - 1 } { \varepsilon _ { r 1 } } \rho _ { e } \quad [ 2 ^ { \prime } ]\tag{81}$$

$$\rho = \rho _ { b } + \rho _ { e } = \frac { \rho _ { e } } { \varepsilon _ { r 1 } }\tag{82}$$

$$\sigma_{0}=P(r)=\frac{\varepsilon_{r1}-1}{\varepsilon_{r1}}\frac{\rho_{e}r}{3}\tag{83}$$

一个薄球壳具有磁矩:

$$\mathrm{d}m = \int_{0}^{\pi} 2 \pi \rho R^{2} \sin \theta \mathrm{d}\theta \mathrm{d}R \cdot \frac{\omega}{2 \pi} \cdot \pi (R \sin \theta)^{2} = \frac{4 \pi}{3} \rho \omega R^{4} \mathrm{d}R\tag{84}$$

总磁矩为

$$m = \frac{4\pi}{3} \sigma_0 \omega r^4 + \int_{0}^{r} \frac{4\pi}{3} \rho \omega R^4   d R = \frac{4\pi(\varepsilon_{r1} - 1)}{9\varepsilon_{r1}} \rho_0 \omega r^5 + \frac{4\pi}{15\varepsilon_{r1}} \rho_0 \omega r^5 = \left( \frac{4\pi}{9} - \frac{8\pi}{45\varepsilon_{r1}} \right) \rho_0 \omega r^5\tag{85}$$

该磁矩在外部产生偶极磁场

$$\frac{m}{4\pi} \frac{2\hat{r}\cos\theta - \hat{\theta}\sin\theta}{R^3} \quad [2']\tag{86}$$

$$B = \mu_{r2} \mu_0 H = \mu_{r2} \mu_0 \left( \frac{1}{9} - \frac{2}{45 \varepsilon_{r1}} \right) \rho_{e} \omega r^5 \frac{2 \hat{r} \cos \theta - \hat{\theta} \sin \theta}{R^3}\tag{87}$$

(2) 球壳内电极化矢量为

$$P(R)=\frac{\varepsilon_{r2}-1}{\varepsilon_{r2}}D(R)=\frac{\varepsilon_{r2}-1}{\varepsilon_{r2}}\frac{\rho_{e}r^{3}}{3R^{2}}\tag{88}$$

所求极化电荷为

$$\sigma_{1}=-P(R_{1})=-\frac{\varepsilon_{r2}-1}{\varepsilon_{r2}}\frac{\rho_{\mathrm{e}}r^{3}}{3R_{1}^{2}}\quad[2']\tag{89}$$

$$\sigma_{2}=P(R_{2})=-\frac{\varepsilon_{r2}-1}{\varepsilon_{r2}}\frac{\rho_{c}r^{3}}{3R_{2}^{2}}\tag{90}$$

(91)

球壳内磁化强度为

$$M = ( \mu _ { r 2 } - 1 ) \mu _ { 0 } H \quad [ 2 ^ { \prime } ]\tag{92}$$

面电流为

$$J_{1} = M \times \hat{n}_{1} = (\mu_{r2} - 1)\mu_{0}(\frac{1}{9} - \frac{2}{45\varepsilon_{r1}})\rho_{e}\omega r^{5}\frac{\hat{\varphi}\sin\theta}{R_{1}^{3}}\tag{93}$$

$$J_{2} = M \times \hat{n}_{2} = - (\mu_{r2} - 1)\mu_{0}(\frac{1}{9} - \frac{2}{45\varepsilon_{r1}})\rho_{e}\omega r^{5}\frac{\hat{\varphi}\sin\theta}{R_{2}^{3}}\tag{94}$$

(3) 介质球内部电场为:

$$E(R)=\frac{D(R)}{\varepsilon_{r1}\varepsilon_{0}}=\frac{\rho_{e}R}{3\varepsilon_{r1}\varepsilon_{0}}\tag{95}$$

介质球内部磁场由内部偶极和外部球壳构成。外部球壳的贡献为（匀强磁场）:

$$H_{2} = \frac{2}{3} \omega \hat{z} \left( \int_{R}^{r} \frac{\rho_{\mathrm{e}}}{\varepsilon_{\mathrm{r}1}} R \mathrm{d}R + \frac{\varepsilon_{\mathrm{r}1} - 1}{\varepsilon_{\mathrm{r}1}} \frac{\rho_{\mathrm{e}} r}{3} \right) = \frac{2 \hat{z}}{3 \varepsilon_{\mathrm{r}1}} \mu_{0} \omega \rho_{\mathrm{e}} \left[ - \frac{1}{2} R^{2} + \left( \frac{1}{3} \varepsilon_{\mathrm{r}1} + \frac{1}{6} \right) r^{2} \right]\tag{96}$$

内部贡献为偶极场:

$$m_{1} = \int_{0}^{R} \frac{4\pi}{3} \rho \omega R^{4} \mathrm{d}R = \frac{4\pi}{15} \rho \omega R^{5}\tag{97}$$

$$H_{1} = \frac{m_{1}}{4\pi} \frac{2\hat{r}\cos\theta - \hat{\theta}\sin\theta}{R^{3}} = \frac{\rho_{c}\omega R^{2}}{15\varepsilon_{r1}}(2\hat{r}\cos\theta - \hat{\theta}\sin\theta)\tag{98}$$

总磁感应强度为

$$\boldsymbol { B } = \mu _ { r 1 } \mu _ { 0 } ( \boldsymbol { H } _ { 1 } + \boldsymbol { H } _ { 2 } )\tag{99}$$

(1) 问16 分:(78)(81)(84)(85)(86) 2 分，(83)(87) 3 分

(2) 问 14分:(88)-(92) 2 分，(93)(94)3 分

(3) 问 10分:(95)2分，(96)(98)4分

questions.answer:
(1) 球壳外部电场 $E(R)=\dfrac{\rho_{c}r^{3}}{3\varepsilon_{r2}\varepsilon_{0}R^{2}}$，磁感应强度 $B = \mu_{r2} \mu_0 \left( \dfrac{1}{9} - \dfrac{2}{45 \varepsilon_{r1}} \right) \rho_{e} \omega r^5 \dfrac{2 \hat{r} \cos \theta - \hat{\theta} \sin \theta}{R^3}$；

(2) 极化电荷 $\sigma_{1}=-\dfrac{\varepsilon_{r2}-1}{\varepsilon_{r2}}\dfrac{\rho_{\mathrm{e}}r^{3}}{3R_{1}^{2}}$，$\sigma_{2}=-\dfrac{\varepsilon_{r2}-1}{\varepsilon_{r2}}\dfrac{\rho_{c}r^{3}}{3R_{2}^{2}}$，面电流 $J_{1}$、$J_{2}$ 见式(93)(94)；

(3) 介质球内部 $E(R)=\dfrac{\rho_{e}R}{3\varepsilon_{r1}\varepsilon_{0}}$，总磁感应强度 $\boldsymbol { B } = \mu _ { r 1 } \mu _ { 0 } ( \boldsymbol { H } _ { 1 } + \boldsymbol { H } _ { 2 } )$。
